text: # New Hire Foundations: Handling Billing Queries **Document ID:** TRN_001 **Category:** GENERAL — Cross-Category / General **Department:** Customer Care **Customer Scope:** all **Last Updated:** 2026-04-20 **Version:** 1.0 **Source Authority:** Internal Knowledge Base --- ## Learning Objectives - Understand the customer scenario this module covers and why it matters. - Apply the correct process steps consistently and within SLA. - Recognise when to escalate rather than continue troubleshooting. ## Core Content # New Hire Foundations: Handling Billing Queries **Document ID:** TRN_001 **Department:** Customer Care **Category:** General (C01-C29) **Last Updated:** 2026-07-21 **Version:** 1.0 --- ## Learning Objectives By the end of this module, agents can explain bill components, identify common dispute types, and apply the correct SOP. ## Scenario 1 **Customer:** "Why is my bill higher this month?" **Correct Approach:** Pull up the itemised bill, walk through each line item, check for plan changes or roaming usage, and offer to raise a dispute if the customer disagrees with a specific charge. ## Scenario 2 **Customer:** "I was charged for a VAS I never subscribed to." **Correct Approach:** Check subscription history for the activation channel (SMS/USSD/app click). If consent cannot be verified, process a refund per SOP_C10_VAS_DISPUTE and deactivate the service. ## Assessment Checklist - [ ] Agent verified customer identity before discussing account details - [ ] Agent explained charges in plain language - [ ] Agent offered next steps (dispute/refund/escalation) where appropriate ## Key Definitions - **SLA** — the target time within which a request or issue should be resolved. -
